review_description: Sales representative really knew his products.Organized all aspects of the job.Installers were courteous and efficient.Couldn't be more happy.

Ben kept me up to date both by phone and email. He sent me information about the product with the quote. A lot of quotes I received were just that - quotes, which told me nothing of their product. Ben was always reachable and always able to help when I had questions. I felt safe in dealing with him as he built up trust with me.
Thank you. The people you gave to me, helped me a lot in chosing the products I needed.

There are too many variances between the quality and output of solar panels and inverters to confuse the purchaser during the decision making process.I would like to see more detail (output, expected life of component, reliability, system losses, etc), including comparisons between different types/brands of solar panels and inverters to enable the purchaser to make an informed decision on solar system other than price and salesperson's spiel.
